evidence: The client keeps the two runtime maps between sessions (SaveGames HydraRiftDynamicInstanceJson.sav / HydraRiftPlayerInstanceJson.sav). Compared rift by rift with those files as the game cached them for another account on WB's servers (2025-02-14; kept out of the repository). same = equal there, differs = not equal, judgment = no evidence either way (the cache holds no RiftConfigs). A cache written while playing on the TS server (2025-10) equals this file exactly, as it should: it is this answer.

kinds.static: the same for every player: game config, catalog, or a server setting

statuses.captured: one frozen value for everyone that was one account's own data
